operations.name: Merge Sort
operations.description: Splits to single elements, then merges sorted runs one comparison at a time.

presets.name: Already Sorted
presets.description: Boundary: merges still run, so mergesort does not adapt.

presets.name: Reverse Sorted
presets.description: Boundary: every merge takes the full run length.

presets.name: All Duplicates
presets.description: Boundary: ties must break consistently to stay stable.

presets.name: Single Element
presets.description: Boundary: no merge is needed at all.

presets.name: Two Elements
presets.description: Boundary: one merge of two length-1 runs.

presets.name: Empty Input
presets.description: Boundary: recursion terminates immediately, no merge runs.

presets.name: Complete Sort
presets.description: Boundary: the whole array sorted and the merge count reported, which is where the trace ends.
